title: Agent Skill Attestation
description: Schema for a skill's attestation.json. Every attestation.json in this repository references this file in its $schema field; until this schema existed, those references resolved to nothing and no attestation was ever validated against anything.

skill_name.description: Must equal the skill's directory name and the 'name' in its SKILL.md frontmatter.

attestation_status.description: DRAFT: authored, passes the linter, not yet evaluated. TESTED: evaluated on at least one model with a passing trigger suite. VERIFIED: multi-platform verified with linked evidence. DEPRECATED: superseded.

capabilities.description: What this skill's code is permitted to do. scripts/audit_skill_safety.py derives the same values structurally from the source and fails the build when the code exceeds this declaration.

network.description: 'none' means no module granting network access is imported anywhere in the skill.

process_execution.description: 'none' means the skill cannot spawn a process.

dynamic_code_execution.description: 'none' means no eval/exec/compile/__import__ and no pickle, marshal or importlib.

filesystem.description: Least to most powerful. 'unrestricted' must be declared by anything that writes outside the target workspace.

capabilities_rationale.description: Why each non-minimal capability is needed. Required whenever any capability is above its most restrictive value.

content_digest.description: sha256 over a canonical manifest of every file in the skill except attestation.json itself. Binds this attestation to exact content: edit any file and the digest no longer matches. Produced and verified by scripts/skill_digest.py.

evidence_url.description: Link to a transcript, CI run, or log backing this row. A PASS with no evidence_url is a claim, not a proof.

currency_caveat.description: Why this row may no longer hold: what has changed in the skill since this platform was last exercised. A PASS with no version tag and no re-run should carry one.

version_tag.description: The skill version this row was actually run against.

measurement_basis.description: How these numbers were obtained: sample size, harness, and date. Without it they are unfalsifiable.

methodology_caveat.description: Required when any figure here is illustrative rather than the output of a documented, repeatable measurement. Say so plainly instead of letting a bare number imply rigour it does not have.

security_audit.description: Point-in-time result of running this skill's own capability auditor. Complements the enforced 'capabilities' block above: capabilities are checked on every CI run, this records a specific reviewed run a reader can reproduce.

reproduce.description: The exact command a reader can run to reproduce this result themselves.

allOf.$comment: A VERIFIED skill must name the platforms it was verified on.
